result.detail: Choices made where the specs leave room. (1) The held address and data registers are reset as well, although microarchitecture section 4 says they need no reset; this follows the rtl_design guidance that every flop gets a reset. (2) do_write also requires !bvalid. That case cannot be reached, and the extra term guards against a second response. (3) The testbench reads internal signals only through ports, apart from the irq monitor; it does not use hierarchical references into the RTL. (4) The testbench uses # delays and so needs Verilator --timing. (5) No timescale is used in any file, which avoids Verilator TIMESCALEMOD. (6) The formal proof called for by spec section 8 is deferred, as recorded in the decision artifact. An independent review_record is still needed for this task.
